plugins.name: bridge-mind
plugins.description: ESTP-tuned decision-support skill series: rapid-prototype validation for technical evaluations, a risk/rollback checklist for irreversible or trading decisions (backed by a non-blocking PreToolUse guard and a decision journal), a compound-learning plateau tracker, a system-design devil's-advocate pass, an unfinished-work audit countering Se novelty-chase, and an outward-facing tone check covering the tertiary-Fe blind spot. Triggers on English and Traditional Chinese phrasing, and its output is exempt from terseness/compression modes.
